notes.title: Update Notice - APR 30
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We are going to release an update to fix many issues that you care about! It will improve the game’s stability and player experience. The server will be down for maintenance.

Maintenance Time
12:30 to 13:30 am, APR 30, 2025 UTC+8

[h3]Balance[/h3]
Added different effects triggered upon transformation for Alternate.
[b]The Burning Man[/b]: Applies 6 stacks of Burn to nearby players.
[b]Bloom Split[/b]: Slows nearby players for 2 seconds.
[b]Mistwalker[/b]: Creates a patch of mist beneath the feet of nearby players.

[b]Betrayer[/b]
[b]The Reaper[/b]
Now reveals its target to all players after a brief delay.
Upon the target's death, it drops 3 additional Hearts and advances the Reaper's Evolution.
No longer triggers permanent Mark of Death when health falls below 50.

[h3]Character[/h3]
[b]Psychologist[/b]
Mind Reading: Now always verifies the identities of two players. If fewer than two players are selected by nightfall, random surviving players will be chosen to fill the remaining slots.

"We believe that verifying two players provides a safe experience for the Psychologist. However, verifying only one player—especially if that player is an Alternate—creates a poor experience for that player, as it can lead to the game ending prematurely with little suspense.

[b]Priest[/b]
Cycle of Life: Now marks an operator every night, rather than only marking one when a player dies during the day. Additionally, the display of the Priest’s passive skill buff has been optimized—it now keeps track of which players have been marked in the past.

[h3]Identity Verification Simplification[/h3]
All identity verification effects now only return "Operator" or "Not an Operator" results. The previous verification logic (such as "Alternate", "Not an Alternate", or "Others") has been completely removed.

This change was made to: - Lower the cognitive barrier of identity information - Balance the information asymmetry between Alternate and Betrayer when facing Investigators

Affected Abilities/Items:
• Truth Department (Inquisitor's passive)
• Cycle of Life and Death (Priest's passive)
• Mind Reading (Psychologist's active)
• Lie Detector (Item)
• Empathy (Mutation)

[h3]Bug Fix[/h3]
Fixed an issue where the Lone Echo in monster swarm would incorrectly drop materials 
Fixed an issue that prevented the Director from properly marking other players

notes.title: Update Notes - MAR 28
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We are going to release an update to fix many issues that you care about! It will improve the game’s stability and player experience. The server will be down for maintenance.

[h3]Maintenance Time[/h3]
10:00 to 11:00 am, MAR 28, 2025 UTC+8

[h3]Balance [/h3]
[b]Factions[/b]
Betrayer-Infection
- Cast range reduced from 15m → 5m.

[h3]Items[/h3]
[b]Shotgun[/b]
- Damage adjusted from 18–36 → 14–32.
- shots to down a player increased from 5 → 7.

[b]Rifle[/b]
- Damage per shot reduced from 3×8 → 3×7; bonus multiplier increased from 0.3 → 0.4.
- Shots to down a player increased from 6 → 7.

[b]Axe[/b]
- Critical hit damage increased from 14 → 16.
- Fixed a bug causing guaranteed crits during charged attacks.

[b]Adrenaline Rework[/b]
Previous dodge roll invincibility frames made Adrenaline combos overpowered. Even without i-frames, its strength needed tuning for high-tier roll mutations.
- Old: 25% movespeed + no stamina loss for 10s → New: 20% movespeed + 10 stamina/sec for 12s.

[b]Genesis Hymn & Baby Shark[/b]
- Optimized VFX/SFX to match actual effective ranges.

[b]Scanner[/b]
- Range reduced from 30m → 20m; duration decreased from 120s → 60s.

[h3]Character[/h3]
[b]Engineer[/b]
- Scan range reduced from 30m → 20m.

[b]Inquisitor[/b]
- Name the Accused duration reduced from 75s → 60s.

[b]Director[/b]
- Fixed a bug where her monkey explosions caused infinite marking.

[b]Gunner[/b]
- Active (Ammo Crate): No longer grants +25% weapon damage; now applies slow on next few shots.
- Passive: Replaced +25% weapon damage with +3 flat weapon damage.

[b]Agent[/b]
- Active skill duration reduced from 30s → 20s.

[b]Psychologist[/b]
- Passive: Full sanity → 80%+ sanity.
- Healing reduced from 3 HP/s → 2 HP/s; duration halved (10s → 5s).

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[b]Dodge Roll[/b]
- Reverted i-frames logic. Rolls now take damage from dynamic objects.

[b]Mutation[/b]
- Adjusted probability distribution by tier to prevent extreme high/low rolls:
  - Lv1: Unchanged.
  - Lv2: 0/5/50/45 → 0/0/60/40.
  - Lv3: 3/62/15/20 → 0/65/35/0.
  - Lv4: 7/50/30/13 → 20/60/20/0.
  - Lv5: Unchanged.

[b]Strange Items[/b]
- Fixed inflated drop rates for Second Chance, D6, Panacea, and Rubber Duck.
- New item: Gravity Anomaly – Periodically deploy traps that pull players inward and deal damage.

[b]Operating Table[/b]
- Interaction time increased from 2s → 3s to prevent unintended mid-combat use.

[h3]Audio & VFX[/h3]
- Fixed Camera weapon SFX (no longer sounds like a shotgun).
- Added missing SFX for Alternate transformations.
- New audio cue for [Call of Darkness] and [Wicker Man] remaining duration.
- Adjusted Electric/Gas Trap VFX to match actual ranges.

[h3]UI[/h3]
- Fixed hidden single-digit values for crafting materials >20.
- Resolved button flickering in Impostor skill selection UI.
- Restored partial Surveillance Room UI.
- Replaced irrelevant lore on script selection screen with gameplay tips.
- Added player level display in pre-game lobby.

[h3]Others[/h3]
- New April 1 login rewards & shop rotation.
- Added Avatar Frame Backgrounds (affects lobby, profile, and friend cards).
- Fixed texture errors on select skins.

notes.title: Spring Sale & MAR 14 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We are going to release an update with many optimizations and new content! The server will be down for maintenance.


[b]Maintenance Time[/b]
MAR 14, 10：00 - 11：00 (UTC+8)

[b]Spring Sale[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528931/ca65f2afc32b56cf4748af4cb2b9ce86d1572da2.png[/img]

Mistery is to be included in the Steam Spring Sale with a discount of 20%!

[b]New Characters[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528931/12b5f92279e15d6791f14f52f1edc03a06b04468.png[/img]

Rocker can set up his stage anywhere and make the audience dance to it. Because of his rebellious spirit, rocker's faction cannot be detected.

Director can place an invisible mannequin that charges towards other players or monsters as they approach, and blows itself up. Once her trap or doll has dealt damage to a player, it temporarily tags that player.

[b]Item[/b]
- Some of the combat props give instant regen. This can be a very frustrating experience sometimes.
- Most recovery props now have a 0.65-second spell time.

- Scanners & Traps
Traps can now be detected by scanners and the Engineer's active skill. 

- Guns
Balanced the strength of firearms with melee weapons at different ranges.

- Shotgun
Range from 15->7
Magazine from 12->10
Damage +1 as compensation (17~35 --> 18~36)

- Rifle
Range from 15 -> 12
Rate of fire from 0.9 shots/sec -> 1.25 shots/sec (additional damage is reduced from 0.45 to 0.3)

- Pistol
Range from 15->12

- Machine Gun
Range 15->12

[b]From the Mist[/b]
- Alternate
Floras are now generated continuously throughout the game.
Alternates can still use their abilities without collecting Floras, but it has a 300-second cooldown at the start of the game.

- Monitor Station
This information is now broadcast to all players via the message alert bar in the upper left corner when someone is using the monitoring room.

[b]Containment Breachout[/b]
- 3 difficulties: Damage Adjustment, Alienation, and Disaster.
- Additionally, some camp upgrades now no longer provide bonuses limited to the area around the camp, but instead provide bonuses to all players in the squad.

[b]UI[/b]
- Updated the UI for Quests, Bright Lights Progress & Workbenches to improve their usefulness and friendliness to newbies.
- Clock time will now go exactly on a day-dusk-night scale.

[b]Beginner's guide[/b]
- A more detailed newbie guide has been added to the board. The “Enable Orientation” tab has been reset for all players.
- When the guide is turned on, a guide line leading from the shelter to the ID card building will be displayed at the beginning of the game.
- Changed the icons for some characters and pseudo-human abilities.
Modified some of the levels and flow of the newbie guide to make it more friendly to newbie players.

[b]Languages[/b]
Optimized the text of some keywords.

[b]Others[/b]
Added a new BP.

[b]Optimization[/b]
- Optimized character loading to reduce memory usage.
- Performance optimization of scene performance.

Dear players,
